name: Trazodone
metabolism: CYP3A4-mediated oxidative cleavage forms active m-chlorophenylpiperazine (mCPP). Other metabolic routes are less well characterized; very little trazodone is excreted unchanged in urine.
summary: Trazodone is an oral antidepressant of the serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor class, used to treat major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, and insomnia.
